cases.name: autoplay-muted-scrolled-out

measure.js: (async () => { const log = []; for (const n of ['play', 'pause', 'playing']) v.addEventListener(n, () => log.push(n + '@' + Math.round(scrollY))); const adv = async () => { const a = v.currentTime; await sleep(900); return {paused: v.paused, advanced: v.currentTime - a > 0.5}; }; const out = {}; await sleep(800); out.out_of_view_first = await adv(); scrollTo(0, 2900); await sleep(300); out.scrolled_in = await adv(); scrollTo(0, 0); await sleep(300); out.scrolled_out_again = await adv(); scrollTo(0, 2900); await sleep(300); out.scrolled_back_in = await adv(); out.events = log; return out; })()
